products.name: SJC Lacto PDRN (Sodium PDRN)
products.description:
Reportedly the first of its kind developed in Korea, Lacto-PDRN is a non-animal, fermentation-derived PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide) produced through fermentation of the probiotic strain Lactobacillus rhamnosus. It resolves the supply volatility and animal-origin concerns long associated with conventional fish-derived PDRN (typically extracted from salmon milt), yielding a highly purified core active — Sodium DNA — through precision microbial fermentation and refinement.
Beyond the intrinsic regenerative capacity of PDRN in supporting cellular renewal and tissue repair, Lacto-PDRN acts as a multi-functional active with pronounced anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. It suppresses inflammatory mediators to calm reactive skin, while neutralizing oxidative stress to protect skin cells — reinforcing the skin barrier and restoring balance to compromised, irritated skin from within.
Its fermentation-based, non-animal origin offers a compelling narrative for vegan, clean-beauty, and sustainability-driven global brands, with proven versatility across sera, essences, creams, and masks in regenerative skincare formulations.

products.name: SJC Cica Repair 4 (Asiaticoside,Madecassic Acid,Asiatoc Acid)
products.description:
SJC Cica Repair 4 is a high-performance repair active in which the three core bioactive components of Centella Asiatica — Asiaticoside, Madecassic Acid, and Asiatic Acid (TECA) — are stabilized at 4% concentration through nano-liposome encapsulation technology. This approach fundamentally resolves the formulation instability and uneven dispersion long associated with conventional Centella-derived ingredients in water-phase systems, while simultaneously maximizing skin absorption and the delivery efficiency of the active components.
Beyond its potent antioxidant and anti-aging properties, SJC Cica Repair 4 functions as a multi-functional repair solution that supports the recovery of damaged skin tissue, soothes irritation, and promotes cellular regeneration. Its excellent formulation versatility — dispersible uniformly in both oil and water phases — allows seamless application across a wide range of skincare formats, from high-viscosity emulsions to essences and serums.
Already adopted by leading K-beauty brands, SJC Cica Repair 4 is a proven, formulation-stable Centella solution that OEM/ODM formulators can confidently incorporate into new product development with speed and reliability.

products.name: SJC Natural Emuls MSB (100% Natural Emulsifier system with Hydrogenated Lecithin etc)
products.description:
SJC Natural Emuls MSB is a 100% plant-derived, stand-alone emulsifier built on a precise combination of Hydrogenated Lecithin with Myristic Acid, Stearic Acid, Behenic Acid, Stearyl Alcohol, and Behenyl Alcohol. Its skin-friendly emulsification system — combining phospholipid, fatty acid, and fatty alcohol components — closely mimics the skin's own lipid structure, delivering a naturally compatible sensory feel without the residue often associated with synthetic emulsifiers.
Effective at a low usage level of just 1–5%, it forms a stable emulsification system across the full range of O/W formulation types. With an NOI (Natural Origin Index) of 1, this fully nature-derived emulsifier retains lecithin's characteristic soft, creamy sensory profile while delivering emulsifying power and texture enhancement on par with synthetic alternatives.
Purpose-built to meet the Clean Beauty movement's core demand for replacing synthetic emulsifiers, SJC Natural Emuls MSB functions as a stand-alone emulsification solution requiring no auxiliary co-emulsifiers — simplifying formulation while enabling true clean-label O/W systems for next-generation skincare.

products.name: SJC Shea Lipid30 (SJC Shea Butter 30% Delivery System)
products.description:
SJC Shea Lipid 30 is a water-solubilized lipid delivery system that stably incorporates Shea Butter — one of the most nourishing plant-derived butters — into water-based formulations at a remarkably high loading of 30%. Built on a precision emulsification framework of Hydrogenated Lecithin and Polyglyceryl-10 Stearate, it disperses and stabilizes high-content butter uniformly within the water phase, overcoming the loading limitations that have long constrained conventional oil-phase butter systems — a true next-generation Phyto-Lipid Delivery solution.
What sets it apart is its ability to translate this high-content butter system into a flowable spray format. Unlike conventional butter formulations, which tend to be heavy and slow to spread, SJC Shea Lipid 30 achieves water-like fluidity, enabling a distinctly new usage experience — moving "from butter you apply to butter you spray." It delivers a light, mist-like application while fully preserving Shea Butter's signature deep moisturizing and nourishing benefits, satisfying both effortless spreadability and rich nutritive performance at once.
As demand for butter spray formats accelerates across the body care and hair care markets, SJC Shea Lipid 30 — with its full formulation versatility and strong Clean & Natural appeal — stands out as an ideal ingredient for brands developing differentiated new formats and compelling storytelling-driven marketing.

products.name: SJC Ceramide 45 Natural (Combined with 6 Types/High level of Ceramide)
products.description:
SJC Ceramide 45 Natural is a flagship active that translates the biomimetic replication of healthy skin's lipid structure into a high-content, fully naturally derived ceramide complex. Precisely blending five ceramide types — Ceramide EOP, NS, NP, AS, and AP — with Cholesterol, it forms a six-component sphingolipid complex in which each ceramide performs a distinct function within the skin barrier, working together to create a synergistic effect.
Stabilized at an industry-leading 45% concentration in powder form, it is composed entirely of naturally derived ingredients, achieving an NOI (Natural Origin Index) of 1 In-vivo clinical data confirm measurable improvements in moisture loss and turnover cycle normalization, substantiating its powerful moisturizing and skin-barrier-reinforcing performance along with complementary benefits such as atopic care.
Available across powder, complex, and biogel platforms, SJC Ceramide 45 Natural is compatible with all formulation types — and with its fully natural-origin positioning squarely aligned to the 2026 Clean Beauty trend and robust clinical substantiation, it gives brand teams a highly persuasive story to build on.

products.name: SJC GG (Glyceryl Glucoside)
products.description:

SJC GG is a naturally derived, multifunctional moisturizer suited to a broad range of formulation types, including skin care, hair care, and cleansing products. Backed by strong moisture-binding capacity, its core skin-barrier-strengthening function effectively supports the regeneration of stressed and aged skin, while also delivering daily UV protection — allowing a single ingredient to fulfill hydration, regeneration, and sun-defense roles at once. Backed by available clinical data, it offers formulators objective, evidence-based substantiation for its performance claims.

products.name: SJC-P20MG (PPG-20 Methyl Glucose Ether)
products.description:

SJC-P20MG (INCI: PPG-20 Methyl Glucose Ether, a humectant/moisturizer) is a multifunctional ingredient for skin and hair care. It is generally regarded as safe (GRAS) for cosmetic use. As a humectant, it retains moisture effectively and prevents dryness in both skin and haircare formulations. It minimizes scalp damage from bleaching and other chemical treatments while reducing irritation. It also softens hair strands and delivers an excellent coating effect with UV protection. Fully compatible with cold-process manufacturing, it offers formulators an easy, energy-efficient solution.

products.name: SJC-EPDM147 (PEG/PPG-14/7 DimethylEther)
products.description:
INCI Name: PEG/PPG-14/7 Dimethyl Ether (Water-Soluble Emollient)
SJC-EPDM147 (INCI: PEG/PPG-14/7 Dimethyl Ether) is a water-soluble emollient designed for skin and hair care formulations. As part of an advanced emollient portfolio combining ester, triglyceride, and polymer technologies, it delivers immediate skin-softening benefits by smoothing the skin's surface and enhancing tactile elegance. Being water-soluble, it provides a moisturizing yet non-oily sensory feel, making it especially well suited to water-based formulations. Its amphiphilic, non-greasy nature offers excellent compatibility across aqueous systems, supporting the development of sophisticated, oil-free formulas. It fits a wide range of applications, from lightweight serums to hair care treatments, creating a smooth, supple finish. Overall, it enables formulators to achieve luxurious sensory experiences without heaviness or oiliness.

products.name: SJC-ISG T20EX (PEG-20 Glyceryl Triisostearate)
products.description:
INCI Name: PEG-20 Glyceryl Triisostearate (Non-ionic O/W Emulsifier, Cleansing)
SJC-ISG T20EX (INCI: PEG-20 Glyceryl Triisostearate) is a non-ionic, PEG-20-ethoxylated glyceryl ester surfactant with an HLB value of 8, positioning it as a mild yet effective oil-in-water (O/W) emulsifying and cleansing agent. Its amphiphilic glyceryl/sorbitan-type backbone efficiently emulsifies and solubilizes sebum, makeup, and oil-based impurities, enabling clean and complete removal from the skin surface. Unlike harsh anionic surfactants, it cleanses gently without disrupting the skin barrier, leaving skin thoroughly hydrated and free of post-cleansing tightness. It is also highly effective at breaking down water-resistant, oil-based sun care formulations, ensuring residue-free rinse-off. This makes SJC-ISG T20EX a versatile emulsifier for cleansing creams, cleansing balms/oils, gentle foaming cleansers, and sun care removers. Its stable emulsification performance and skin-conditioning profile support the formulation of premium, sensory-refined cleansing products.

products.name: SJC-PGIS23 (Polyglyceryl-2 Triisostearate)
products.description:
INCI Name: Polyglyceryl-2 Triisostearate (Water-in-Oil Emulsifier, HLB 3)
SJC-PGIS23 (INCI: Polyglyceryl-2 Triisostearate) is a lipophilic, non-ionic polyglycerol ester with a low HLB value of 3, making it a highly effective water-in-oil (W/O) emulsifier. Its low-HLB, oil-continuous structure firmly encapsulates the water phase within the oil phase, forming a robust occlusive barrier on the skin that minimizes transepidermal water loss (TEWL) while imparting a soothing, moisturized feel. As a polyglycerol-based emulsifier, it promotes stable mixing and phase compatibility between oil and water, effectively suppressing phase separation and emulsion breakdown over time to extend product shelf life. It also functions as an excellent pigment dispersant, uniformly wetting and stabilizing inorganic UV filters and pigments—an essential property for sun care and color cosmetic formulations. Its ester-based, polyglycerol backbone further contributes strong oxidative stability, protecting the formulation from rancidity and degradation. Being plant-derived and readily biodegradable, SJC-PGIS23 supports the development of stable, sensorially refined W/O emulsions for sun care, skin care, and cleansing applications with a favorable environmental profile.
